description: FrontMCP's skills catalog (@frontmcp/skills): instructions for building with FrontMCP, from setting up a project to production readiness. Without `name`, lists the skills. With `name`, returns its SKILL.md and the reference files beside it; with `file` too, that file. Skills are step-by-step guides written for coding agents: for the docs themselves use search_docs or get_page, and for runnable code get_example. The catalog is the newest FrontMCP release's, so the tool takes no version.

file.description: One of the skill's reference files, as listed, like "references/create-tool.md".

name: get_skill
title: Read a FrontMCP skill
